Input image 2 is ONLY the desired lighting/material/background style reference, never its products.

The background fills the whole square edge to edge. Front labels clearly readable, elegant slight three-quarter viewpoint. Output ONE SQUARE image, 1:1, requested 3840 x 3840 pixels for a 4K square export. No landscape frame, no border, no collage, no UI, no external lettering, no watermarks, no vase or flowers. Do not invent text, certifications or branding, do not redesign the packaging.
